Lisa — thanks for the PO and details. Welcome — excited to get NebulaCorp live. A couple of clarifications and next steps so we can map the right procurement lane: 

1) Intake form: we do have a short vendor intake (attached) that captures marketplace-specific fields (AWS seller ID / Azure publisher ID / GCP partner ID). Please fill the Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx and return it to us. That speeds up the listing and billing mapping.

2) PO routing: for marketplace-enabled procurement we route the signed PO to our billing portal via procure@procurecloud.com (ProcureCloud handles ingestion + document store) and we also need a copy to accounts-payable@redwood.com for manual review on exceptions. Sending to both is fine.

3) Marketplace lane: if you plan to list on multiple marketplaces we recommend picking a primary launch (we usually do AWS first unless there's a contractual reason otherwise) — this affects the seller/publisher ID flow and the invoicing cadence. If you want, Vanessa will propose the recommended lane based on your contract terms.

4) Timeline: once we have the completed intake form and the signed PO in ProcureCloud, typical ingestion + billing setup is ~7 business days. Marketplace listing (catalog + billing) can take an additional 7–14 days depending on the marketplace.

Next steps checklist:
- Complete Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx (attached)
- Confirm whether AWS/Azure/GCP is primary at launch
- Upload signed PO to procure@procurecloud.com and cc accounts-payable@redwood.com
- We will raise a HubSpot ticket (HS-789012) and share DocuSign link if any signature is needed on our side

I'll loop Vanessa for the marketplace lane recommendation.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Strategic Onboarding — Redwood Inference
T: 650-555-0123
